latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of healthcare-call-notes-zh.

- Converts raw transcripts from healthcare/medical conference calls into standardized meeting notes in Chinese.
- Ensures high completeness, proper terminology correction, Q&A reconstruction, and preserves key information.
- Special handling of industry-specific errors; requires explicit time-stamp marking for low-confidence or unclear content.
- Structured output suitable for buy-side/sell-side research documentation and future referencing.
- Strict rules to avoid fabrication; all uncertain information is clearly labeled and sourced.
